source: Codex probiotic registry audit (26 findings) and a second review (10 corrections), both relayed by Sean B on 2026-09-22
audited_snapshot_note: Codex audited an intermediate registry (after Dr Pham's decisions, before the explicit-direction pass).
verification: Every cited PMID fetched live from PubMed (efetch XML); DRACMA (PMC11415968), Bi-26 (PMC13167951) and the 2025 Prodentis RCT (PMC12380889) read in open-access full text. The BB-12 preterm, NCFM child-cold, Bl-04 and BS01 full texts are not open access, so their primary endpoints stay unresolved.
scope_rule: Label-bounded catalog of supplements and medications: identities absent from every catalog label are not added (MIMBb75).

A01.action: HEAL9 review reopened; single-strain RCT 37571403 recorded; Dr Pham's withdrawal of the HEAL9 + 8700:2 trial stands

A02.action: 431 source type corrected in pham_review_20260922.py; vaccine-response benefit claim removed

A03.action: M-16V: combination trial no longer its anchor; NEC claim removed; anchored to strain-specific review 28796951 (null)

A04.action: DRACMA context: LGG tolerance and wheezing estimates removed from CRL431 + BB-12; scoring stays disabled

A05.action: Prodentis single-strain aliases removed; strain-level credit fail-closed; 2025 null RCT added

A06.action: ATCC PTA 6475 mixed: 2024 null RCT (38865129) added; BMD recorded as a surrogate

A07.action: CTV-05 intravaginal evidence gives oral labels no credit (direction unresolved)

A08.action: all strain summaries state an explicit direction; the scorer fails closed on a missing one

A09.action: UABla-12 solo-arm context added; DDS-1 record's stale limitations corrected

A10.action: Nissle recorded as human active-comparator equivalence evidence; unsourced 'EMA approved' removed

A11.action: indications and benefits bound to their records for K12, HN001, BB536, IS-2, BC30, SP1, DSM 17938 (score-neutral: relevance is metadata)

A12.action: 8700:2, ME-3, 1714 source types corrected; 1714 RCTs 38355674 and 42060410 recorded (both primary null); ME-3 kefir trial has no PubMed record and is not added

A14.action: 35624 dose-ranging RCT 16863564 recorded; Shirota stress/sleep not added (no Shirota label in the catalog); BC30 2025 trial's primary endpoint left unresolved (abstract names none)

A15.action: LGG acute-gastroenteritis RCT 30462938 (null) and 299v IBS RCT 22912552 recorded

A16.action: LAFTI L10 identity follows the label and current sources (L. helveticus); RCT 27363733 recorded; acidophilus-era identity left unproven

A17.action: resistant maltodextrin moved to its own 'Resistant Dextrin' entry; 'polyphenol-based prebiotic' and 'guar fiber' aliases removed

A18.action: industry CFU bands already labelled convention in every note; dose applicability uses study contexts, not the bands

A19.action: the 6 contexts whose hierarchy could change credit were checked; no open-access source names a primary endpoint, so they stay unresolved

A20.action: validator rejects a primary outcome carrying a subgroup or companion role; derivation ignores within-group, subgroup, companion and ranking effects; LGG pain and GR-1 MDR records corrected

A21.action: BC30 + enzymes and the synbiotic pasta contexts made ineligible (co-formulated or food interventions)

A22.action: derived 'strong' now needs two positive trials of the same condition

A23.action: measured transit reclassified as a surrogate; Bi-26 adverse-event limitation added

A24.action: Bi-26 dose recorded from full text as an end-of-shelf-life minimum; CU1 intermittent schedule noted

A25.action: IS-2 yes count 3; stale NCFM, Lpc-37, Prodentis and IS-2 notes rewritten

A26.action: MIMBb75 appears on no catalog label; the registry is label-bounded

R3.action: SP1 acne pilot 27596801 added; both indications kept, modestly

R5.action: 1714 claims and level brought in line with its null-primary RCTs

R7.action: Prodentis fail-closed; ATCC 55730 and PTA 5289 aliases removed

R8.action: STRAIN_BOULARDII_CNCM_I745 created; six I-745 records moved; I-745 and Florastor aliases moved

R9.action: Enterogermina alias removed from the species node; its trials are formula-level

R10.action: M-16V anchored to 28796951: no significant RCT benefit, very low certainty
